members.name: manager-schemes

members.deliverable: At least 10 direct official HTTP probes with exact chain, Location, final URL, canonical, access date, claims and EXPAND tail.

members.name: help-schemes
members.focus: help.thefork.com and official support host scheme and hostname variants
members.deliverable: At least 10 direct official HTTP probes with exact chain, Location, final URL, canonical, access date, claims and EXPAND tail.

members.name: locale-paths
members.focus: locale-less and alternate locale paths on manager/help official hosts
members.deliverable: At least 10 direct official HTTP probes across en-GB, en, fr, de, es, it, nl or discovered locales; exact chains and canonicals; claims and EXPAND.

members.name: article-aliases
members.focus: known and discoverable official TheFork help article aliases and manager help paths
members.deliverable: Discover aliases from official sitemap/search and probe at least 10 paths, recording exact chains/finals/canonicals and EXPAND.

members.name: normalization

members.deliverable: At least 10 paired direct probes with exact redirect preservation/removal behavior, final URL and canonical, claims and EXPAND.

members.name: counter-verifier
members.focus: independent red-team repeat of representative manager/help chains using GET and HEAD, different user agents, loop and off-domain detection
members.deliverable: At least 10 independent probes, discrepancies versus expected behavior, final URL/canonical, claims and EXPAND.
